profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary: EECS Bachelors graduate from MIT. I love working with HW/SW systems, edge devices, and tiny ML. I think IOT can make our world a much better place and I’m always looking for new technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Git · Machine Learning · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · Cloud Development · Cloud Computing · Go (Programming Language) · Unit Testing

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description:
-Helping college-bound high schoolers around the nation better their resume, academics, and essays so they can attend their dream school.

-Assisting students with STEM-related homework assignments and programming interests

-Providing robust test preparation for the SAT, ACT, and AP Tests

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
-Developed an intuitive QR code-based access system integrated into a static website, enabling seamless training module retrieval for employees across 20+ countries in Amazon fulfillment centers

-Implemented AWS Lambda@Edge for robust, real-time authentication of employee credentials, enhancing the security and integrity of training content access globally.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon S3 · Amazon CloudWatch · Amazon Dynamodb · Java · Amazon CloudFront · Customer Experience · NoSQL · JavaScript · React.js

positions.title: Data Activism Educator
positions.description:
-Utilized Pandas and Seaborn libraries to extract data on Environmental Justice, Food Insecurity, and Housing in Boston

-Developed custom functions class using Pandas and Seaborn to make data extraction beginner friendly for high school students

-Provided mentorship and support to students for creating data visualizations and a published ArcGIS story map displaying survey results and research statistics
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Tutoring · ArcGIS Products

positions.title: Shift Lead
positions.description:
-Helped to train and manage employees and assign positions for an ideally functioning shift

-Assessed sales to determine an ideal income to labor-cost ratio

-Kept inventory and maintaining food and work safety in compliance with FDA and ServSafe® standards

certifications.title: Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification

honors.title: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship Recipient
honors.description: A prestigious scholarship by Amazon rewarded to 250 people nationwide with a value of $40,000 and a guaranteed internship at Amazon.

volunteerExperiences.description: I tutor two high school students. I tutor a freshman through the Algebra 1 curriculum, while working with a high school Junior in Various AP courses including Calculus, Psychology, and United States History. Through this experience I tutor but also serve as a mentor to ambitious students in need.
Worked directly with College Board staff members to discuss methods with my peers to get more students college ready.
